title: Characterization of the boundedness of the discrete Fractional maximal operator between weighted in Lorentz sequence spaces
summary: In this paper, we give the complete characterization of the boundedness of the discrete fractional maximal operator $M_γ$, defined on $\mathbb{Z}^n$, $n\in\mathbb{N}$, $γ\in [0,n)$, between the classical Lorentz sequence spaces $λ_p(v)$ and $λ_q(w)$, where $0<p,q<\infty$, $\{v(m)\}$ and $\{w(m)\}$ are non-negative sequences defined on $\mathbb{N}$. We first obtain a sharp upper estimate for the nonincreasing rearrangement of the discrete fractional maximal operator $M_γx$, with a supremal operator involving a discrete Hardy operator and the nonincreasing rearrangement of the sequence…
